input.instruction: My workbook has two tables. Sheet "Sheet1" records the sales of a boomerang company. Sheet "Retail Price" lists the retail prices for all products. I want to calculate the revenue for each transaction in the sales table considering corresponding retail price and discount. Please help me do this in a new column with header "Revenue".

steps: Treat Sheet1 and Retail Price as two tables; join on Product to read Retail Price.
Fill Revenue on every Sheet1 data row from that lookup plus Quantity and Discount.
